description: RAPID: Assessing the Performance of Elevated Wood Buildings, including Manufactured Housing, in Florida during 2018 Hurricane Michael is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Elaina Sutley, University of Kansas (ku.edu). Hurricane Michael made landfall as a Category 4 hurricane on October 10, 2018. This hurricane was the strongest to hit the continental United States since Hurricane Andrew in 1992. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-85fv-n684. Keywords: Hurricane Michael; Elevated Buildings; Manufactured Homes; Mobile Homes; Wind Engineering. Published 2019-06-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
